title: Berkshire Hathaway Invest $330 Million in Bending Spoons
text:
Berkshire Hathaway has agreed to invest $330 million in Italian digital conglomerate Bending Spoons in a private placement of stock, providing a boost to investor confidence in Bending Spoons. Shares of the Italian company leapt 40% to $52.88 on Wednesday.
